posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
IIRC it's against the site rules to advertise paid products with the sole exception of RPG Maker games or GGG's own products.
You're going to need to find a plugin that modifies the inventory scene. You could just look in Cursed Mansion's plugins folder to see what plugins they're using
